attempts.summary: Restored `/srv/legacy2/mail-filter-routing/bin/deliver`. It now atomically routes messages by case-insensitive `X-Department` header, preserves input bytes, creates unique deliveries, retains samples, and persists across reboot. AlmaLinux 9.6 and kernel 5.14.0-570.12.1.el9_6.x86_64 remain unchanged.
